Container.Name: play-pokemon-attendance
Container.Overview: Enter Play! Pokémon league attendance into play-tools in one click. Keeps your regulars, imports TOM .tdf files, and shows which players to promote or retire.[br][br]First run: open the WebUI and enter the setup code printed in this container's log (Docker tab → this container → Logs) to create the organizer account. Then connect your Pokémon account under Settings. No passwords go in this template.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database and generated secrets. Back up this whole folder (Appdata Backup); always restore secrets/ together with app.db.

Config.Name: Site URL
Config.Description: Only when the app sits behind an HTTPS reverse proxy, e.g. https://attendance.example.com. Leave empty for LAN access.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the files in appdata (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the files in appdata (100 = users).

Config.Name: Session password (override)
Config.Description: Leave empty: generated on first boot into appdata/secrets/. Set only to manage it yourself (at least 32 characters).

Config.Name: Token vault key (override)
Config.Description: Leave empty: generated on first boot into appdata/secrets/. Set only to keep the key off this volume (32 bytes, base64).
